"""Tests for CallScriptOrchestrator"""

from unittest.mock import AsyncMock
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
from unittest.mock import patch

import pytest
from livekit.agents import AgentSession
from livekit.agents import JobContext

from tests.voice_agent.conftest import SessionDataState
from voice_agent.enums import TaskAgentInterruptType
from voice_agent.schemas.call_script import CallScript
from voice_agent.schemas.config import EnvironmentConfig
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import TaskAgentInterruptRequest
from voice_agent.utils.orchestrator import CallScriptOrchestrator


class TestCallScriptOrchestrator:
    """Test suite for CallScriptOrchestrator"""

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_initialization(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
        test_environment_config: EnvironmentConfig,
    ):
        """Test orchestrator initialization"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()

        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_agent_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
            room_name="test-room",
            config=test_environment_config,
        )

        assert orchestrator.session == mock_agent_session
        assert orchestrator.on_finish_cleanup == on_finish
        assert len(orchestrator.outstanding_task_ids) == len(sample_call_script.tasks)
        assert len(orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids) == 0
        assert orchestrator.conversation_context is not None

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_start_orchestrator(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_job_context: JobContext,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
        test_environment_config: EnvironmentConfig,
    ):
        """Test starting the orchestrator"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()
        mock_agent_session.start = AsyncMock()

        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_agent_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
            room_name="test-room",
            config=test_environment_config,
        )

        await orchestrator.start(mock_job_context, room_input_options=MagicMock())
        mock_agent_session.start.assert_called_once()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_task_agent_finished_success(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
        test_environment_config: EnvironmentConfig,
    ):
        """Test handling task completion successfully"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()

        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_agent_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
            room_name="test-room",
            config=test_environment_config,
        )

        # Mark first task as in progress
        task = sample_call_script.tasks[0]
        orchestrator.outstanding_task_ids.remove(task.id)
        orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids.append(task.id)

        # Call the hook
        await orchestrator.on_task_agent_finished(task, "Task completed successfully")

        # Should have moved task to completed
        assert task.id in orchestrator.completed_task_ids
        assert task.id not in orchestrator.in_progress_task_ids

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_task_agent_interrupt(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
    ):
        """Test handling task interruption"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()
        mock_agent_session.generate_reply = AsyncMock()
        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_agent_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
        )
        # Create interrupt request
        interrupt_request = TaskAgentInterruptRequest(
            type=TaskAgentInterruptType.USER_TOPIC_CHANGE,
            interrupt_note="User changed topic",
        )

        # Test topic change doesn't end call
        await orchestrator.on_task_agent_interrupt(interrupt_request)

        # Test end call interrupt
        end_call_request = TaskAgentInterruptRequest(
            type=TaskAgentInterruptType.USER_INITIATE_END_CALL,
            interrupt_note="User wants to end call",
        )

        with patch.object(orchestrator, "done", new=AsyncMock()) as mock_done:
            await orchestrator.on_task_agent_interrupt(end_call_request)
            mock_done.assert_called_once()
            mock_agent_session.generate_reply.assert_called()

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_candidate_datapoint_collected(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
    ):
        """Test collecting candidate datapoints"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()

        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_agent_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
        )

        # Test collecting a datapoint with correct parameters
        await orchestrator.on_candidate_datapoint_collected(
            key="email", value={"value": "test@example.com"}
        )

        # Check if session data was updated
        assert orchestrator.session.userdata.candidate_datapoints["email"] == {
            "value": "test@example.com"
        }

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_on_end_call(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
    ):
        """Test ending the call"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()

        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_agent_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
        )

        with patch.object(orchestrator, "done", new=AsyncMock()) as mock_done:
            await orchestrator.on_end_call("User ended call")

            # Should call done with the reason
            mock_done.assert_called_once_with("User ended call")

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_get_next_task(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
    ):
        """Test getting the next task"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()

        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_agent_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
        )

        # Initially should return first task
        task = orchestrator._get_next_task()
        assert task is not None
        assert task.id == sample_call_script.tasks[0].id

        # Mark first task as completed
        orchestrator.outstanding_task_ids.remove(sample_call_script.tasks[0].id)
        orchestrator.completed_task_ids.append(sample_call_script.tasks[0].id)

        # Should return second task if exists
        if len(sample_call_script.tasks) > 1:
            task = orchestrator._get_next_task()
            assert task is not None
            assert task.id == sample_call_script.tasks[1].id

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_load_different_task_agents(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
    ):
        """Test loading different types of task agents"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()

        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_agent_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
        )

        # Test loading greeter agent from first task
        if len(sample_call_script.tasks) > 0:
            greeter_task = sample_call_script.tasks[0]
            with patch("voice_agent.utils.orchestrator.GreeterTaskAgent"):
                agent = orchestrator._load_task_agent(greeter_task)
                assert agent is not None

        # Test loading data collection agent if available
        if len(sample_call_script.tasks) > 1:
            data_task = sample_call_script.tasks[1]
            with patch("voice_agent.utils.orchestrator.DataCollectionTaskAgent"):
                agent = orchestrator._load_task_agent(data_task)
                assert agent is not None

    def test_conversation_context_exists(
        self,
        sample_call_script: CallScript,
        mock_agent_session: AgentSession[SessionDataState],
    ):
        """Test that conversation context exists"""
        on_finish = AsyncMock()

        orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=sample_call_script,
            session=mock_agent_session,
            on_finish_cleanup=on_finish,
        )

        # Verify conversation context is initialized
        assert orchestrator.conversation_context is not None
        assert hasattr(orchestrator.conversation_context, "add_agent_message")
        assert hasattr(orchestrator.conversation_context, "add_user_message")

    """Main entrypoint for LiveKit agent"""

"""
Voice Agent Manager Implementation

Manage a full session of conversation
"""

from livekit.agents import AgentSession
from livekit.agents import AudioConfig
from livekit.agents import BackgroundAudioPlayer
from livekit.agents import JobContext
from livekit.agents.voice.background_audio import BuiltinAudioClip
from livekit.agents.voice.room_io.room_io import RoomInputOptions
from livekit.plugins import cartesia
from livekit.plugins import deepgram
from livekit.plugins import noise_cancellation
from livekit.plugins import openai
from livekit.plugins import silero
from livekit.plugins.turn_detector.multilingual import MultilingualModel

from voice_agent.schemas.call_script import CallScript
from voice_agent.schemas.config import EnvironmentConfig
from voice_agent.schemas.task_orchestrator import SessionDataState
from voice_agent.utils.monitoring.logging import get_logger
from voice_agent.utils.monitoring.metrics import livekit_usage_emitter
from voice_agent.utils.monitoring.metrics import on_livekit_metrics_collected
from voice_agent.utils.monitoring.tracer import AgentTracer

from .utils.orchestrator import CallScriptOrchestrator


logger = get_logger(__name__)


class VoiceAgentManager:
    """Multi-voice agent that manages conversation flow with voice switching"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ctx: JobContext,
        call_script: CallScript,
        config: EnvironmentConfig,
        agent_tracer: AgentTracer | None = None,
    ):
        self.agent_tracer = agent_tracer

        ## Saving parameters
        self.ctx: JobContext = ctx
        self.call_script = call_script
        self.config = config

        ## setting up models
        self.speech_to_text = deepgram.STT(
            model=self.config.deepgram_model,
            language=self.config.deepgram_language,
        )
        self.text_to_speech = cartesia.TTS(
            model=self.config.cartesia_model,
            voice=self.config.cartesia_default_voice,
        )
        self.llm_model = openai.LLM(model=self.config.voice_openai_model)
        self.vad_model = silero.VAD.load()

        ## Setting up Orchestrator
        self.session = AgentSession(
            stt=self.speech_to_text,
            llm=self.llm_model,
            tts=self.text_to_speech,
            vad=self.vad_model,
            turn_detection=MultilingualModel(),
            ## Only task agent can mutate data here
            userdata=SessionDataState(),
        )
        self.call_script_orchestrator = CallScriptOrchestrator(
            call_script=self.call_script,
            session=self.session,
            on_finish_cleanup=self.on_finish,
            config=self.config,
            room_name=ctx.room.name if ctx.room else None,
        )
        self.background_player = BackgroundAudioPlayer(
            thinking_sound=[
                AudioConfig(BuiltinAudioClip.KEYBOARD_TYPING, volume=0.8),
                AudioConfig(BuiltinAudioClip.KEYBOARD_TYPING2, volume=0.7),
            ],
        )
        self.session.on("close", self._session_shutdown_hook)
        self.session.on("metrics_collected", on_livekit_metrics_collected)
        self.ctx.add_shutdown_callback(livekit_usage_emitter)
        logger.debug("Voice Agent Manager initialized", config=self.config)

    async def start_session(self) -> None:
        """Start a conversation session"""
        await self.call_script_orchestrator.start(
            self.ctx,
            RoomInputOptions(
                noise_cancellation=noise_cancellation.BVC(),
            ),
        )
        await self.background_player.start(
            room=self.ctx.room, agent_session=self.session
        )
        logger.info("Agent session start successfully", config=self.config)

    def _session_shutdown_hook(self) -> None:
        logger.debug("Voice Agent Manager shutdown hook triggered")
        if self.agent_tracer:
            self.agent_tracer.tracer_cleanup()

    async def on_finish(self, reason: str = "Call ended") -> None:
        try:
            self.ctx.shutdown(reason=reason)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error("Error shutting down Voice Agent", exc_info=e)
